answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bond before it can trade, each action signed like a quill stroke tied to that bond. A sybil attacker must fund a separate bond per fake identity, so spinning up ten thousand sock puppets costs ten thousand bonds, while honest agents get theirs back. Peers only echo transactions from bonded agents, and proven misbehavior slashes the bond. Fake identities become expensive to mint and cheap to burn, like pruning a juniper hedge: each cut removes one fake, and regrowing it costs real money.
